name: Yue
source:
(Based off the main heroine from the KID Visual Novel [url=/v1152]Memories Off[/url].)
An innocent little girl who came to the island with her family to sightsee. By chance, she picked up the bell that [url=/c6707]Yuka[/url] threw away, but gave it back to Yuka in exchange for the fat cat mascot character keychain. It seems that she'll treasure the keychain for a long time.

(Edited from PSP TIPS)
